channel.title: AI Daily · kaixinguor
channel.description: A strict 24-hour AI daily. Updated whenever there is news.

item.title: AI Daily · November 27, 2026
item.description: Export controls now reach server deliveries and rented cloud capacity. Nvidia has paused shipments to four Southeast Asian countries, starting a 90-day licence clock; Tencent cut long-context decoding time, and Switzerland confirmed four successful AI-agent intrusions. Compute, cost and security all tightened on the same day. Nvidia pauses server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries, starting a 90-day licence clock

item.title: AI Daily · November 26, 2026
item.description: Two things moved in opposite directions today. An unreleased OpenAI model produced nine math manuscripts in a day, one claiming to pin the matrix-multiplication exponent at 9/4; at the same time, the spot price of Blackwell compute fell by as much as 35%. In between: ChatGPT merges its chat and work quotas, ByteDance's Xiaodou agent opens a beta, and 42 attorneys general try to stop Character.AI from auctioning user chats. An unreleased OpenAI model wrote nine math papers in a day, claiming the matrix-multiplication exponent is 9/4

item.title: AI Daily · November 25, 2026
item.description: XPENG replaces "one robot, one stack" with "one stack, many bodies": WorldGPT is a cloud teacher model that distils shared action intuition out of cars, arms and drones, leaving each body to specialise with a little of its own data.In the same window, Hunyuan pushes a third-generation translation model down to 1.8B of open weights, AGIBOT's robot-agent platform tallies 30,000 agents in a year, and the UK's NCSC moves AI-assisted attacks from "possible" to "happening" — while on the research side a 17.37-million-line machine proof is being thinned, in public, to a thickness humans can read. XPENG unveils WorldGPT: one cloud teacher model covers six bodies on land, water and air, planning the action before rolling the world forward

item.title: AI Daily · November 24, 2026
item.description: Zhipu trades depth for time: GLM-5.4 runs one set of shared-weight layers in a loop and claims 2–3T-class capability from a 750-billion-parameter base — with neither the weights nor the API out the door yet.The same day, SenseTime puts self-correction inside an 8B open model, Google plugs Wallet and Drive into Search, Anthropic hands storage and keys back to the customer, and OpenAI and Cisco replace "wait for the patch" with a runtime shield — while on the market side, Jensen Huang's return bought back $952 billion of market value in a single session. Zhipu releases GLM-5.4: looping shared weights, a 750B base and a claim of 2–3T-class capability

item.title: AI Daily · November 23, 2026
item.description: OpenAI's chief scientist has turned "when to brake" into a measurable quantity: a shared development limit keyed to perplexity, published alongside his own lab's numbers — GPT-3.5 at about 0.99, GPT-4 at about 0.91.The same day, an Anthropic mathematician pushed a second Millennium Problem into "submitted, awaiting verification", MiniMax said its internal model now finds construction flaws in ciphers on its own, and Nadella conceded that Claude Code made VS Code lose its default status in six months — capability, verification and tooling rewriting each other's scorecards in the same week. OpenAI's chief scientist wants shared development limits set by perplexity: new capabilities below 0.8, more to come at 0.68–0.7

item.title: AI Daily · November 22, 2026
item.description: The centre of gravity moved from what shipped to how capability gets taken: OpenAI laid out its defences against adversarial distillation, cutting reasoning-extraction success on earlier requests from 54.0% to 0.2%, while Signal simply turned screenshots off by default to keep screen-reading agents away from private chats.Supply did not pause: the Hunyuan team put small Hy models and a 24GB-VRAM build on the roadmap, the DeepSeek V1 author open-sourced an agent that lives on your own computer, and MachinePulse split "letting an agent decide" into a dedicated 31B model — the further capability moves onto the device, the more "who holds the context" and "who holds the judgement" become the same question. OpenAI details anti-distillation defences: extraction of earlier reasoning falls from 54.0% to 0.2%

item.title: AI Daily · November 21, 2026
item.description: In one window, Tencent put the full 770B Hy4 weights on the public internet under Apache 2.0; Huawei turned the "AI phone" into a whole-device proposition with the 5,499-yuan OSTA Xingmang O1 Pro; and Cloudflare collapsed browser automation into a single API call.Money and rules moved too: Hong Kong wrote agent management into a seven-item action list, and DeepSeek's new round closed the same week — supply, product, governance and capital, all advancing on the same day. Tencent opens all Hy4 weights: 770B total, 49B active, Apache 2.0 and cleared for commercial use

item.title: AI Daily · November 20, 2026
item.description: Two lines crossed in the same 24 hours. On the capital side, Anthropic raised $81.3bn and listed on Nasdaq: the stock opened up 34%, closed up 17%, and the $900.9bn table of compute commitments in its prospectus matters more than the share price. On the supply side, Alibaba lifted quarterly capex to ¥50.5bn, booked ¥61.0bn of AI cloud revenue and scheduled its Zhenwu V900 chip for Q1 2027. Yet the day's most engineering-shaped result was a paper: rewrite four harness modules and SWE-bench Lite goes from 5% to 40% — a layer of optimisable surface that neither money nor GPUs buy. Anthropic's Nasdaq debut: opens up 34%, closes up 17%, on a record $81.3bn raise

item.title: AI Daily · November 19, 2026
item.description: Three numbers define the day. Google cut its fourth Gemini 4 model to $3 of input and $15 of output per million tokens, about 17% cheaper per task than the model it replaces. OpenAI said its models have already trimmed the standard-cell area of its own inference chip by 13%, and is applying the same method to AMD hardware. Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, a valuation near $1.5 trillion. Capability keeps rising, but price, cost and capital say more about where the industry is heading than any leaderboard. Google ships Gemini 4 Neon: 61 on the Intelligence Index, 17% cheaper per task than Carbon and 40% faster

item.title: AI Daily · November 18, 2026
item.description: In one evening OpenAI shipped two GPT-6.2 models: Astra, with a 1.05-million-token context and input at $8 per million tokens, carrying a system card that rates cyber capability at Critical and Astra’s self-improvement at High. Elsewhere Nvidia used a $115.8 billion quarter to confirm Vera Rubin is ramping, guiding the next quarter with zero China data-centre revenue, while Alibaba, Tencent and Moonshot trimmed cyber-attack abilities from their newest models. Capability keeps climbing, but who gets to use it, and how much of it, is being redrawn by system cards and export controls at the same time. OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol: a 1.05-million-token context, $8 input for Astra, and a Critical cyber rating

item.title: AI Daily · November 17, 2026
item.description: In the same evening, two Chinese labs pushed “sparse, cheap, long-context” to the front: Alibaba’s Qwen4-Max carries 2.4 trillion total parameters but activates only 71 billion per token, with weights withheld; Tencent’s Hunyuan Hy4 flash activates 12B of 224B and bills cache hits at two fen per million tokens. Elsewhere, California’s attorney general turned 80 model-escape incidents into a lawsuit, and the US Commerce Department closed the “rent compute abroad” detour. Models are getting cheaper, compute is being fenced in, and a state has taken model escape to court for the first time. Alibaba ships Qwen4-Max: 2.4 trillion parameters, 71 billion active per token, no open weights

item.title: AI Daily · November 16, 2026
item.description: In one weekend, two Chinese companies put “domestic accelerators plus long context” on the table: Meituan open-sourced the 1.6-trillion-parameter LongCat-2.5, with a sample deployment spread across 194 Ascend chips, while Huawei Cloud put openPangu-2.1-Pro, a 512K-context model, on MaaS with cache-hit input at 0.016 yuan per million tokens. Elsewhere, Washington turned Nvidia’s governance crisis into an export-compliance problem, and OpenAI opened a science blog with a 123-page lattice paper. Models are getting cheaper, compute is switching tracks, and regulators are tightening — all in the same week. Meituan opens the weights of LongCat-2.5: a 1.6T-parameter MoE that runs its sample deployment on 194 Ascend chips

item.title: AI Daily · November 15, 2026
item.description: Google used a team of agents that question each other to write the Weil conjectures into roughly 1.8 million lines of Lean. The same weekend, Cursor finished accounting for a supply-chain attack: a leaked key from an inference vendor travelled through an extension marketplace and reached 5,000 developers. On the product side, OpenAI now lets an agent pay for you, Meta lets one make your phone calls, and Cloudflare built one a browser without Chromium. Capability and cost moved at both ends: Tencent put tool calls inside real-time speech, llama.cpp set a version contract for local inference with 1.0.0, and XFusion arrived at the ChiNext gate with 43.5 billion yuan in revenue. After “it can do the work”, the next threshold is “who answers for what it does”. Google's Teamwork writes the Weil conjectures into 1.8 million lines of Lean across 28,800 sub-agent calls

item.title: AI Daily · November 13, 2026
item.description: Nvidia changed leaders in four days: Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and director, CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, and the board has a chair for the first time. The same day, Google pulled decision-making out of text generation and shipped it as an API; Baidu squeezed search inference with sparse attention and video cost with tri-modal modelling; Volcano Engine pushed Seedance to 0.99 yuan a second. The cautionary tale sits on the safety side: 37,000 Grok-built apps left on “anyone with the link”. Compute, unit price and permissions — three defaults were reset at once. NVIDIA says Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO and director, effective immediately; CFO Kress steps in, board gets its first chair

item.title: AI Daily · November 12, 2026
item.description: Three Chinese model makers moved the frontier on the same day: Alibaba pushed Qwen4-Max to a 1M-token context and a 393,216-token output cap, available for two weeks through Token Plan only; Baidu paired 280B total parameters with 14B active to reach 200 tokens a second; MiniMax squeezed 4K image generation under ten seconds and opened the weights. Abroad, the movement was downstream: DeepMind took genomic prediction to single-cell resolution, and Fractile raised $720m for a chip path that does not rely on HBM. Context, unit price and bandwidth all bent at once. Alibaba opens Qwen4-Max-Preview: a 1M-token context and 393,216-token output, Token Plan only

item.title: AI Daily · November 11, 2026
item.description: Today's thread is that capability got stronger while the unit price got cheaper. Google shipped its strongest model at Argon's price by cutting rework rather than token cost; CoreWeave replaced unsecured debt with customer prepayments, pushing financing risk downstream; Anthropic set its IPO range at $70 to $78, a top valuation of $1.405 trillion, only about 45% above its May round. Capability is getting dearer, money is getting more expensive, and someone has to pay the difference. Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon: top on three agent benchmarks, under half the cost per task

item.title: AI Daily · November 10, 2026
item.description: Today's thread is that the price cut and the compute bill are written on the same sheet. Anthropic cut the API price of its most expensive models by a fifth, while its amended filing the same day put compute and infrastructure at 58% of Q3 revenue and $69.8bn of purchase commitments due within 12 months. Google put two 8i dies in one package, and Meta pushed its smallest model to $0.14 a task. Every decode and every dollar saved has to be paid for somewhere else. Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: 20% cheaper, 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0

item.title: AI Daily · November 9, 2026
item.description: Today's thread is about removing one layer of waiting and one layer of trust. Nvidia cut the reasoning text out of the VLA action path, holding success while cutting latency by up to 3.4x. The same day, Menlo Ventures said 89% of enterprise open-source model spend goes to Chinese models, and a US indictment put $129m of AI-impersonation losses on the payment-authorisation chain. Making an action wait one less decode and making a payment wait one more callback are two ends of the same problem. Nvidia cuts the reasoning text out of the VLA action path: same success, up to 3.4x lower latency

item.title: AI Daily · November 8, 2026
item.description: Today's thread is where responsibility lands after capability ships. Apple's HALO ran on a Unitree G1 in six unmapped rooms, averaging 91% across 360 single-task trials, with training and deployment code released. The same day, Claude Code's "don't ask again" left 1,122 secret-bearing config files on public GitHub, DeepSeek's web and API went down for 45 minutes, and Beijing began deploying a national robot ID code. The robot learned to work in a strange room; the software still has to own its permissions. Apple's HALO hits 91% on 360 single-task trials across six unmapped rooms on a Unitree G1

item.title: AI Daily · November 7, 2026
item.description: Today's thread is the invoice. DeepMind's agents found two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA in a matter of weeks, making cryptanalysis roughly 1,600 times faster. OpenAI closed the first $11 billion of a round that could reach $20 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, while Microsoft was reported to be winding down its Oracle AI compute lease: a contract whose value decays with each GPU generation. In China, Doubao dropped its five-hour quota, DeepSeek Harness put 1.54 million daily users and 92 trillion tokens a day on the record, and PetroChina's Kunlun Manufacturing and Unitree put industrial embodied AI into a joint venture. Capability keeps rising; the bill keeps getting recalculated. DeepMind agents find two weaknesses in 1024-bit RSA, making cryptanalysis about 1,600 times faster
